name: Tail and Compass — Personalized Itinerary Generator (MVP corrected)

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Inbound trigger. No credentials required. Your application POSTs { job_id, trip_id } here after the user approves a draft itinerary.

nodes.name: Respond 202 (Accepted)
nodes.notes: Responds immediately with HTTP 202. Execution continues asynchronously after this node.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Non-secret configuration. The Supabase API key itself is stored in the Supabase credential, never here.

nodes.name: Get Generation Job
nodes.notes: Requires Supabase API credential (service_role key recommended for private storage + row access).

nodes.name: Prepare Image Plan
nodes.notes: Builds up to 2 image prompts and the photo strategy. Photo logic is internal and not exposed to the end user.

nodes.name: Generate Image
nodes.notes: Requires OpenAI API credential. Processes one image per item; on failure the item is routed to the error output and the remaining image continues.

nodes.name: Upload Image to Storage
nodes.notes: Uploads the generated image to a private Supabase Storage bucket. Authenticates with the Supabase API credential (no hardcoded keys).

nodes.name: Record Image Result
nodes.notes: Only successful uploads reach this node. Captures storage path, scene, caption and an inline data URI used to embed the image in the PDF.

nodes.name: Aggregate Images
nodes.notes: Collects the successful images (0, 1 or 2). The workflow continues even if every image failed.

nodes.name: Build Itinerary HTML
nodes.notes: Builds the itinerary HTML with a cream/brown/orange style. Generated images are embedded near the relevant sections. The image model is never asked to build the PDF layout.

nodes.name: HTML to PDF
nodes.notes: Placeholder HTML-to-PDF service. Configure the endpoint (and any auth credential) later. Gotenberg users: switch to multipart/form-data with an index.html file field. Returns the PDF as binary "data".

nodes.name: Upload PDF to Storage
nodes.notes: Uploads the PDF to a private Supabase Storage bucket using the Supabase API credential.

fieldValues.fieldValue: ={{ $("Aggregate Images").first().json.images.map(i => ({ scene: i.scene, storage_path: i.storage_path, caption: i.caption })) }}

nodes.name: Mark Job Completed
nodes.notes: Final success update. The frontend polls this row and stops its waiting animation when status becomes "completed".

fieldValues.fieldValue: We could not generate your itinerary PDF. Please try again.

nodes.name: Mark Job Failed
nodes.notes: Error branch. Writes a short, user-safe message only. Never stores API keys, signed URLs, stack traces or raw provider responses.

nodes.name: Stop: Missing or Duplicate
nodes.notes: Reached when the job row does not exist, or is already processing/completed. Prevents duplicate images/PDFs.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ {"error": "Missing required fields: both job_id and trip_id are required."} }}
